core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette, Streatham High Road, SW16
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on the first and second floors above a commercial unit on Streatham High Road, with its own entrance and a section 42 lease extension notice already served that can be assigned to the buyer. The property has a bay-fronted living room and a kitchen fitted in 2022.

The living room measures 4.90m x 4.10m into bay (16'1" x 13'5" into bay) and overlooks the High Road. The kitchen measures 3.20m x 2.30m (10'6" x 7'7"). On the upper floor, bedroom one measures 3.85m x 3.05m (12'8" x 10'0") and bedroom two measures 2.70m x 2.40m (8'10" x 7'10"). There is one bathroom.

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. There is no parking; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approx. 6 minutes' walk and Streatham Common is approx. 10 minutes' walk.

Offers in excess of £375,000. Leasehold with 89 years remaining; ground rent £350 per year, doubling every 25 years with the next increase in 2034; service charge £960 per year (year ending December 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C. EPC rating D. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. There is a right of access via the rear service yard shared with the commercial unit and a shared bin store. Chain involved.
core.summary: Own entrance to this first and second floor maisonette on Streatham High Road, with a bay-fronted living room, kitchen fitted 2022 and a section 42 lease extension notice served that can be assigned to the buyer.
